full.description: This is a gross specimen photograph showing the opened anterior lower chest and abdominal cavity of a neonate. The internal organs are exposed, revealing a prominent liver on the right and multiple loops of intestine. The anatomical arrangement appears disrupted or complex, consistent with a congenital malformation or conjoined twinning evaluation. The tissues display deep red and dark brown hues typical of fresh post-mortem pathologic specimens.

blind.description: This image is a gross specimen showing the joined lower chest and abdomen of conjoined twins. The anterior wall is opened to reveal the internal organs, specifically showing duplicated intestinal tracts and a shared or duplicated liver. The anatomical configuration is characteristic of conjoined or siamese twins. This illustrates a complex congenital malformation involving multiple thoracoabdominal structures.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing an autopsy view of the abdominal and thoracic cavities. A smooth, enlarged, dark-colored liver occupies a significant portion of the upper right quadrant, alongside visible loops of the intestine. The dark discoloration and altered organ appearance are suggestive of severe systemic disease or congenital anomalies. Further examination of these visceral organs is indicative of a pediatric autopsy case.
